extraction.Name: Victoria Lapointe Meng
extraction.Refused/Protested: No. Many years of the Indians had received theirs and I thought it too late to send it back.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold 80 acres; retained 80 acres; did not mortgage the remainder
extraction.NOTES: Has two children, ages six and three; sold 80 acres for $2000.00 cash; retained 80 acres; land appraised at $6500 for the quarter and $3500 for the remaining 80 acres; pays $93 to $97 per year in taxes; assessor appraises land too high; later bought a new car for $1300.00 from the same man; no debts settled at time of sale; no other debts against the land; received patent in mail at home; satisfied with the sale; document references 'Yisterial Victoria Lapointe Collins' as an alternate name form; subscribed and sworn April 26, 1929; document number 2878
